steps.en: Automatically approved requests are passed to the public portal side
steps.id: Request yang di-approve otomatis diteruskan ke sisi portal

steps.en: Officer-approved requests are passed to the public portal side
steps.id: Request yang di-approve officer diteruskan ke sisi portal

steps.en: Only recently approved requests appear in the portal
steps.id: Hanya request approved yang baru yang muncul di portal
steps.why_en: A 3-month window exists but is fixed and counted from submission date, not approval date.
steps.why_id: Jendela 3 bulan ada tetapi tetap dan dihitung dari tanggal submission, bukan tanggal approve.

steps.en: The number of months can be changed from a setting in OCMS
steps.id: Jumlah bulan bisa diubah lewat pengaturan di OCMS
steps.why_en: The month count is typed into the program; no setting exists to change it.
steps.why_id: Jumlah bulan ditulis langsung di program; tidak ada pengaturan untuk mengubahnya.

steps.en: After login, owners can view their approved submissions
steps.id: Setelah login, owner bisa melihat submission approved miliknya
